# EPOXIDOVO s. r. o.

> Slovak manufacturer and installer of poured epoxy and polyurethane resin
> floors, and operator of the EPOXIDOVO Academy epoxy flooring course.
> Based in Ružomberok, installing across the whole of Slovakia.
> Website: https://epoxidovo.sk

## Company facts / Firemné údaje

- Legal name: EPOXIDOVO s. r. o.
- Company ID (IČO): 56966237, Tax ID (DIČ): 2122519135
- Not VAT registered — quoted prices are final
- Address: Plavisko 1956/35, 034 01 Ružomberok, Slovakia
- Phone: +421 948 143 981 · E-mail: obchod@epoxidovo.sk
- Opening hours: Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00 CET
- Service area: all regions of Slovakia (Bratislava, Trnava, Trenčín, Nitra, Žilina, Banská Bystrica, Prešov, Košice)

## What EPOXIDOVO does / Čo robíme

- Single-colour poured epoxy floors — from €59/m² (jednofarebné liate podlahy)
- Flake (chips) floors — from €49/m² (chipsové podlahy)
- Metallic epoxy floors — from €129/m² (metalické podlahy)
- Polyurethane and industrial floors — priced per project
- Certified floor systems: ESD, HACCP, ATEX, anti-slip
- Typical lead time: 3–5 days for floors up to 50 m²; 5–10 days for multi-layer metallic systems
- Expected service life with correct installation and maintenance: 20+ years
- Suitable substrate: concrete cured at least 28 days; older concrete must be ground and tested

## Training / Kurz

- Course: EPOXIDOVO Academy — 2-day hands-on epoxy flooring course
- Slovak page: https://epoxidovo.sk/kurz
- English page: https://epoxidovo.sk/en/epoxy-flooring-course
- Format: in-person workshop in Ružomberok, Slovakia — not an online video course
- Duration: 2 consecutive days, 9:00–17:00 CET (16 hours)
- Group size: maximum 6 participants; each pours roughly 12 m² of real floor
- Price: €690 standard, €1,190 pro package (starter material and tool set included)
- Included: material, tool loan, printed and PDF manual, consumption calculator, sample quote, lunch, certificate of completion, 30 days of instructor support
- Prerequisites: none — suitable for complete beginners
- Language: taught in English (instructor also understands Slovak); manual in English and Slovak
- Covered skills: substrate diagnostics, diamond grinding, priming, two-component resin mixing, single-colour pour, flake broadcast, metallic effect, coving and detailing, job pricing
